captions.linkedin:
We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites with Google Lighthouse on a simulated mid-range phone.

74.3% took more than 4 seconds to show their main content. 32.2%, nearly one in three, took more than 10 seconds. The median was 6.9 seconds. Google’s good mark is 2.5.

These are lab numbers on a deliberately tough test, so treat them as a warning light. But the point holds: a Book Now or Call button that has not loaded yet cannot be tapped, and every blank second is a chance for someone to go back to Google.

Full method: prycedigital.com/research

sources: Pryce Digital Lighthouse study 2026, 12,621 Australian small-business sites (prycedigital.com/research)
